name: Xion Crowld
source:
The ruler of the Feste Castle. He stays in the innermost room on the top floor within the castle. He's from the highest noble house, which explains his innate dignity and gracefulness. He is a gentleman, but one can rarely read his emotions.

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bride-of-the-twilight/id1598260899]English App Store[/url]]
